name: Starpath
summary:
Take the controls of your own spacecraft and answer a distress call from ARIA - a stranded AI with a sharp tongue and a ship full of problems.

Fight through enemy fighters, navigate treacherous comet fields, and reach her before hostile forces do.

A story-driven VR space combat experience for Meta Quest - with endless modes to keep you flying long after the credits roll.

ARIA will guide you through it all. Whether you want her to or not.
